# Evidence

## Claim

T7's SPEC_V2 §12 gate is met by executed tests at lane head `a9ffecb8`.

## Evidence

31 tests run, 31 passed, 1 skipped (`ops`, `ops_write`, `ops_read`, `ops_host`); the clause-to-test
map and the full pass list are `/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`.

## Verification

Re-run: `cargo-guard.py nextest run --locked -p conveyor-actions --test ops --test ops_write
--test ops_read --test ops_host`.

## Links

The manifest `acceptance/programme/T7.toml`, the delivery contract and its Phase-G review, and the
transcript `/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`.

## Gap

The cluster live proof (`scripts/ops-live-proof.sh`) is deploy-bound: its operator CLI is absent
on this box and the deployed digest is `sha256:60898434…` (rollout 2026-11-21T04:38Z). It is not
claimed as executed.
